sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: Setchellanthus caeruleus is a Mexican shrub and the sole species of its genus and family, Setchellanthaceae. It is known from separated regions of northern and south-central Mexico. The original botanical account describes small, nearly sessile, silvery-hairy leaves and solitary blue flowers about 2 cm long; a reliable height was not available in the sources consulted.

sections.title: Flowers and use
sections.text: The vivid blue to lilac petals surround numerous stamens. No edible or medicinal use is established in the sources consulted.
